ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the rising-edge clock used by all clocked processes. It times updates to bus responses, the IRQ, clock generator, phase generator and TWI engine state and registers.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) in processes bus_access, irq_generator, clock_generator, phase_generator, twi_engine

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Provides synchronous reset behavior for all clocked processes; when asserted low it forces registers to defined reset values used across bus response, engine, clock generation and IO flip-flops.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') branches in clocked processes bus_access, irq_generator, clock_generator, phase_generator, twi_engine

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.functionality: Container for bus transaction fields; individual fields are read throughout the design to start transfers, select register accesses and supply write data. The record itself is not assigned here.
role: provides transaction fields to internal logic
ports.evidence: only record fields (bus_req_i.stb, .rw, .addr, .data) are used in code; no whole-record operations

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.function: address bits for bus access selection
ports.functionality: Supplies the address bit used to choose control vs FIFO data accesses. It gates which register fields or FIFO words the bus read/write operations act on.
role: gates bus register vs FIFO accesses
ports.evidence: uses bus_req_i.addr(2) in nested ifs and in concurrent fifo.tx_we and fifo.rx_re when-else conditions

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.functionality: Carries data written by the bus and provides bits used to program control fields and enqueue TX FIFO words; its slices are captured into control registers and FIFO write-data signals.
ports.evidence: bus_access assignments ctrl.* <= bus_req_i.data(...); fifo.tx_wdata <= bus_req_i.data(dcmd_cmd_hi_c downto dcmd_lsb_c)

ports.name: bus_req_i.ben
ports.functionality: Declared in the bus request record but not read or used anywhere in this source; it does not affect logic here.

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.functionality: Indicates an active bus transaction. It is used both as a direct source (ack output) and as a gating condition for internal writes and FIFO read/write enables.
role: gates bus-access assignments and FIFO enables
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb; nested if (bus_req_i.stb='1') and fifo.tx_we/fifo.rx_re when-else expressions

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.functionality: Distinguishes read from write bus transactions and gates which branches of the bus access logic execute, controlling control-register writes and FIFO enqueue/dequeue operations.
role: gates bus-access write vs read paths
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.rw = '1') then ... else ... and used in fifo.tx_we and fifo.rx_re when-else conditions

ports.name: bus_req_i.src
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced in this entity; no behaviour depends on it here.

ports.name: bus_req_i.priv
ports.functionality: Declared in the bus request type but not used in this source code.

ports.name: bus_req_i.debug
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced anywhere in the entity source.

ports.name: bus_req_i.amo
ports.functionality: Declared but not used in this module.

ports.name: bus_req_i.amoop
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced in the source.

ports.name: bus_req_i.lock
ports.functionality: Present in the bus request record but not referenced by any logic in this entity.

ports.name: bus_req_i.fence
ports.functionality: Declared but never referenced in this module's source.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.functionality: Top-level response record driven by bus_access clocked process; its fields report ack, error and data returned to the bus based on bus_req_i and internal state.
ports.evidence: clocked bus_access process assigns bus_rsp_o.ack/err/data from bus_req_i and internal signals

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.ack
ports.functionality: Drives the bus ACK bit; it is set synchronously to the incoming strobe to acknowledge transactions (driven inside bus_access).

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.functionality: Reports bus error status; it is synchronously driven low by the bus_access process (no internal error path here).
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.err <= '0' in bus_access clocked process (reset and active branches)

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.functionality: Synchronous read-data word constructed from control fields, IO sense bits, FIFO status and FIFO read-data; different bit slices are driven from different internal registers inside the bus_access clocked process.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.data(...) assignments in bus_access set slices from ctrl.*, io_con.*, fifo.*, engine.busy

ports.name: clkgen_en_o
ports.functionality: Continuously reflects the internal control enable bit to an external pin; implemented as a direct combinational assignment from ctrl.enable.

ports.name: clkgen_i
ports.functionality: Provides the prescaler clock-source bits; individual bits are indexed by ctrl.prsc and read in the clock generator to decide when to advance the clk_gen counter.
ports.evidence: clkgen_i(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.prsc))) used in clock_generator if condition

ports.name: twi_sda_i
ports.functionality: External SDA line sampled into the module via a small conversion function and provided to internal IO flip-flops (io_con.sda_in).

ports.name: twi_sda_o
ports.functionality: Drives the external SDA pin directly from the internal SDA output signal; it continuously reflects io_con.sda_out.

ports.name: twi_scl_i
ports.functionality: External SCL line sampled and converted into the internal scl input signal for the TWI engine and phase logic.

ports.name: twi_scl_o
ports.functionality: Externally drives SCL from the internal scl_out signal; continuously reflects the internal open-drain drive decision.

ports.name: irq_o
ports.functionality: Synchronous interrupt output asserted when the controller is enabled and a TX FIFO is full while the engine is idle; computed and registered in the irq_generator clocked process from ctrl.enable, fifo.tx_avail and engine.busy.
ports.evidence: irq_o <= ctrl.enable and (not fifo.tx_avail) and (not engine.busy) inside irq_generator (rising_edge(clk_i))

signals.name: ctrl
signals.functionality: Record holding TWI controller configuration (enable, prescaler, clock divider, clock stretch). Its fields are written synchronously from bus write operations and read by other logic for clock and behavior.
signals.evidence: bus_access clocked process assigns ctrl.enable/prsc/cdiv/clkstr <= slices of bus_req_i.data

signals.name: ctrl.enable
signals.functionality: Holds the enabled/disabled state programmed by the bus; written synchronously from bus_req_i.data and used to gate the clock generator, phase generator reset behaviour, and engine state bit2.
signals.evidence: ctrl.enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c) in bus_access; used in clock_generator and phase_generator and assigned into engine.state(2) in twi_engine

signals.name: ctrl.prsc
signals.functionality: Small vector selecting which clkgen_i bit is sampled to gate the clock-divider counter; set from bus writes and used as an index into clkgen_i for tick generation.
signals.evidence: ctrl.prsc <= bus_req_i.data(...); clkgen_i(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.prsc))) used in clock_generator

signals.name: ctrl.cdiv
signals.functionality: Small counter limit used by the clock generator to determine when to assert clk_gen.tick; written by bus accesses and compared to clk_gen.cnt inside the clock generator.
role: compared to clk_gen.cnt to generate tick
signals.evidence: ctrl.cdiv <= bus_req_i.data(...); used in clock_generator when comparing clk_gen.cnt = ctrl.cdiv

signals.name: ctrl.clkstr
signals.functionality: Configures whether the engine should halt the generated clock when the bus line is held low; written from bus and used combinationally in halt condition logic.
signals.evidence: ctrl.clkstr <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_clkstr_en_c) in bus_access; used in clk_gen.halt concurrent assignment

signals.name: fifo
signals.functionality: Record that groups FIFO control, data and status signals; its fields are driven combinationally or by instantiated FIFO components and used by the engine and bus access logic.
role: carries FIFO control and status signals
signals.evidence: fifo is a record aggregated from multiple signals each used individually (see fifo.* entries)

signals.name: fifo.clear
signals.functionality: Combinationally asserts FIFO clear when the controller is disabled (clear = not ctrl.enable); used to clear both RX and TX instantiated FIFOs.
signals.evidence: fifo.clear <= not ctrl.enable (concurrent assignment)

signals.name: fifo.rx_we
signals.functionality: Drives the RX FIFO write enable directly from the engine.done flag when a byte has been received; provided to the rx FIFO instance as its we_i input.
signals.evidence: fifo.rx_we <= engine.done; port map connects we_i => fifo.rx_we on rx_fifo_inst

signals.name: fifo.tx_we
signals.functionality: Computed combinationally from bus transaction strobes and address/rw bits to enqueue TX words; it is connected to the TX FIFO instance write-enable input.
signals.evidence: fifo.tx_we <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb='1') and (bus_req_i.rw='1') and (bus_req_i.addr(2)='1') else '0'; port map we_i => fifo.tx_we

signals.name: fifo.rx_re
signals.functionality: Derived combinationally from a bus read of the RX FIFO address; it asserts when the bus issues a read to the RX FIFO address and is mapped to the rx FIFO re_i input.
signals.evidence: fifo.rx_re <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb='1') and (bus_req_i.rw='0') and (bus_req_i.addr(2)='1') else '0'; port map re_i => fifo.rx_re

signals.name: fifo.tx_re
signals.functionality: Combinationally indicates when the engine should dequeue the next TX command: asserted when engine is idle, TX FIFO has data and a clock tick occurs. It feeds the tx FIFO re_i port.
role: derived from engine and clock generator
signals.evidence: fifo.tx_re <= '1' when (engine.busy='0') and (fifo.tx_avail='1') and (clk_gen.tick='1') else '0'; port map re_i => fifo.tx_re

signals.name: fifo.rx_wdata
signals.functionality: Composed from the engine shift register bits when a byte is received; concatenates sreg(0) and sreg(8 downto 1) and is presented to the rx FIFO wdata input.
signals.evidence: fifo.rx_wdata <= engine.sreg(0) & engine.sreg(8 downto 1); port map wdata_i => fifo.rx_wdata

signals.name: fifo.rx_rdata
signals.functionality: Receives read-data from the instantiated RX FIFO; used to return RX bytes to the bus when the bus reads the RX FIFO address.
signals.evidence: port map rdata_o => fifo.rx_rdata on rx_fifo_inst; bus_access assigns bus_rsp_o.data(8 downto 0) <= fifo.rx_rdata

signals.name: fifo.tx_wdata
signals.functionality: Carries the write-data enqueued to the TX FIFO; constructed from a slice of bus_req_i.data and mapped to the tx FIFO wdata input.
signals.evidence: fifo.tx_wdata <= bus_req_i.data(dcmd_cmd_hi_c downto dcmd_lsb_c); port map wdata_i => fifo.tx_wdata

signals.name: fifo.tx_rdata
signals.functionality: Provided by the instantiated TX FIFO; used by the engine to load the shift register and choose command bits when a TX word is dequeued.
signals.evidence: port map rdata_o => fifo.tx_rdata on tx_fifo_inst; engine.sreg <= fifo.tx_rdata(...) in twi_engine's case "100"

signals.name: fifo.rx_avail
signals.functionality: Indicates RX FIFO has data available; driven by the RX FIFO instance and reported to the bus response data field.
signals.evidence: rx FIFO port map avail_o => fifo.rx_avail; bus_rsp_o.data(...) <= fifo.rx_avail in bus_access

signals.name: fifo.tx_avail
signals.functionality: Indicates the TX FIFO has data available for dequeueing; driven by the TX FIFO instance and used by the engine and bus response logic.
signals.evidence: tx FIFO port map avail_o => fifo.tx_avail; fifo.tx_re uses fifo.tx_avail; bus_rsp_o.data includes fifo.tx_avail in busy bit

signals.name: fifo.rx_free
signals.functionality: Indicates free space in RX FIFO; driven by the RX FIFO instance and not otherwise used in logic in this source.
signals.evidence: rx FIFO port map free_o => fifo.rx_free

signals.name: fifo.tx_free
signals.functionality: Indicates free space in TX FIFO; driven by the TX FIFO instance and reported inverted as tx_full in bus response.
signals.evidence: tx FIFO port map free_o => fifo.tx_free; bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_tx_full_c) <= not fifo.tx_free

signals.name: clk_gen
signals.functionality: Holds clock-generator internal counters, tick, halt and phase state used to produce TWI timing phases and ticks; fields are updated in clocked and concurrent logic.
signals.evidence: clk_gen is a record referenced via its fields in multiple processes (see clk_gen.* entries)

signals.name: clk_gen.cnt
signals.functionality: Counts clock-source events while enabled; compared against ctrl.cdiv to generate clk_gen.tick and reset to zero when matching.
signals.evidence: clk_gen.cnt updated in clock_generator process when ctrl.enable='1' and clkgen_i(index)='1'; compared to ctrl.cdiv

signals.name: clk_gen.tick
signals.functionality: Single-cycle pulse asserting that the divider reached its limit; produced by the clock generator process based on clk_gen.cnt, ctrl.cdiv and selected clkgen_i bit.
signals.evidence: clk_gen.tick set to '1' when clk_gen.cnt = ctrl.cdiv and clkgen_i(...)='1' in clock_generator (rising_edge(clk_i))

signals.name: clk_gen.halt
signals.functionality: Combinational signal that indicates clock generation should be halted when SCL is externally held low and clock-stretching is enabled; computed from scl_out, scl_in_ff and ctrl.clkstr.
signals.evidence: clk_gen.halt <= '1' when (io_con.scl_out='1') and (io_con.scl_in_ff(1)='0') and (ctrl.clkstr='1') else '0' (concurrent)

signals.name: clk_gen.phase_gen
signals.functionality: Holds the rotating one-hot pattern used to derive phase signals; reset to "0001" when disabled or idle, otherwise rotates on clk_gen.tick when not halted.
signals.evidence: phase_generator process updates clk_gen.phase_gen and phase_gen_ff on rising_edge(clk_i); rotation guarded by clk_gen.tick and clk_gen.halt

signals.name: clk_gen.phase_gen_ff
signals.functionality: Flip-flop that holds the previous phase_gen value used to detect rising edges for phase bits; updated each clock from phase_gen.
signals.evidence: clk_gen.phase_gen_ff <= clk_gen.phase_gen in phase_generator (rising_edge(clk_i))

signals.name: clk_gen.phase
signals.functionality: Four combinational phase signals derived from phase_gen and phase_gen_ff to produce single-cycle pulses for phases 0..3 used by the engine to time SDA/SCL transitions.
signals.evidence: clk_gen.phase(n) <= clk_gen.phase_gen_ff(n) and (not clk_gen.phase_gen(n)) concurrent assignments

signals.name: engine
signals.functionality: Record grouping TWI engine state, counters, shift register and status flags; updated in the twi_engine clocked process and read by FIFO and irq logic.
signals.evidence: engine record fields are assigned in twi_engine process (see engine.* entries)

signals.name: engine.state
signals.functionality: Three-bit state register where bit2 is used as enabled flag and bits 1..0 select operation; driven in reset and updated in the twi_engine process by case branches and by loading from FIFO command bits.
signals.evidence: engine.state assigned in twi_engine case; engine.state(2) <= ctrl.enable; in "100" branch engine.state(1 downto 0) <= fifo.tx_rdata(...); engine.busy computed from engine.state

signals.name: engine.bitcnt
signals.functionality: Four-bit counter incremented during shift operations to track transmitted/received bits; updated in twi_engine on phase(3) and reset when starting a transfer.
signals.evidence: engine.bitcnt <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(engine.bitcnt) + 1) when clk_gen.phase(3)='1' in twi_engine

signals.name: engine.sreg
signals.functionality: Holds the byte being transmitted or received; is loaded from TX FIFO data and shifted in/out on phase boundaries, with received bits sampled into its LSB via io_con.sda_in_ff.
role: feeds FIFO RX write-data on completion
signals.evidence: engine.sreg loaded from fifo.tx_rdata in "100" branch; engine.sreg <= engine.sreg(7 downto 0) & io_con.sda_in_ff(1) on clk_gen.phase(2)

signals.name: engine.done
signals.functionality: Single-cycle flag set when a byte transfer completes (engine.bitcnt check) and cleared at the start of each clocked cycle; used to write received data into the RX FIFO.
signals.evidence: engine.done <= '1' when engine.bitcnt = "1001" and clk_gen.phase(0)='1' in twi_engine; engine.done <= '0' at top of cycle

signals.name: engine.busy
signals.functionality: Combinational flag derived from engine.state indicating whether the engine is currently performing a non-idle operation; used by IRQ logic and FIFO dequeue logic.
signals.evidence: engine.busy <= '1' when (engine.state(2)='1') and (engine.state(1 downto 0)/="00") else '0'; used in fifo.tx_re and irq generation and bus_rsp busy bit

signals.name: io_con
signals.functionality: Record grouping sampled inputs, sampled flip-flops and output drive signals for SCL and SDA lines; updated partially in the twi_engine process and via concurrent conversions from external pins.
signals.evidence: io_con record fields used throughout twi_engine and connected to external pins (see io_con.* entries)

signals.name: io_con.sda_in_ff
signals.functionality: Two-stage sampled version of SDA input used for metastability mitigation and sampling of incoming SDA; shifted each clock from io_con.sda_in and used when shifting received bits into engine.sreg and reporting sense bit.
signals.evidence: io_con.sda_in_ff <= io_con.sda_in_ff(0) & io_con.sda_in in twi_engine; engine.sreg uses io_con.sda_in_ff(1); bus_rsp_o.data reads io_con.sda_in_ff(1)

signals.name: io_con.scl_in_ff
signals.functionality: Two-stage sampled version of SCL input used for edge detection and clock-stretch decisions; sampled from io_con.scl_in and used in clk_gen.halt and bus status reporting.
signals.evidence: io_con.scl_in_ff <= io_con.scl_in_ff(0) & io_con.scl_in in twi_engine; clk_gen.halt uses io_con.scl_in_ff(1); bus_rsp_o.data reads io_con.scl_in_ff(1)

signals.name: io_con.sda_in
signals.functionality: Converted form of the external twi_sda_i input (via to_stdulogic(to_bit(...))); used as the sampling source for the SDA input flip-flops.
signals.evidence: io_con.sda_in <= to_stdulogic(to_bit(twi_sda_i)) (concurrent); used in io_con.sda_in_ff <= io_con.sda_in_ff(0) & io_con.sda_in

signals.name: io_con.scl_in
signals.functionality: Converted form of the external twi_scl_i input and the sampling source for the SCL input flip-flops.
signals.evidence: io_con.scl_in <= to_stdulogic(to_bit(twi_scl_i)) (concurrent); used in io_con.scl_in_ff <= io_con.scl_in_ff(0) & io_con.scl_in

signals.name: io_con.sda_out
signals.functionality: Open-drain drive decision for SDA, held across cycles and updated in twi_engine according to phase and state; exported to the external twi_sda_o pin.
signals.evidence: io_con.sda_out set in twi_engine branches based on clk_gen.phase and engine.sreg; twi_sda_o <= io_con.sda_out

signals.name: io_con.scl_out
signals.functionality: Open-drain drive decision for SCL, updated in the engine according to phases and exported to the external twi_scl_o pin; used also in halt detection.
signals.evidence: io_con.scl_out assigned in twi_engine case branches using clk_gen.phase; twi_scl_o <= io_con.scl_out and clk_gen.halt uses io_con.scl_out
